title: Finite relation cokernels descend along a directed ring colimit
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed partially ordered set, $F:I\to\mathrm{CRing}$ a functor, and $A=\operatorname{colim}_I F$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For natural numbers $m,n$ and an $A$-linear map $q:A^m\to A^n$, there exist $i\in I$ and an $F_i$-linear map $q_i:F_i^m\to F_i^n$ such that extension of scalars along $F_i\to A$ identifies $F_i^n/\operatorname{im}(q_i)$ with $A^n/\operatorname{im}(q)$. The quotients may be transported to any module universe containing the ring universe using the canonical universe-lift equivalence. No module finite-presentation hypothesis or conclusion is part of this statement.

proof.text: Use the standard finite bases to write q as an n by m matrix. Lift its finitely many entries to a common stage by the elementwise representation criterion and directedness. Define qi by the represented matrix.

Tensoring a cokernel presentation is right exact. Identify the extensions of the two finite free modules by their standard bases. Under these identifications the represented matrix becomes q; the induced quotient comparison is an isomorphism. Transport through the canonical ULift linear equivalences when a larger module universe is requested.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stage_finite_relation_cokernel
    {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat) (n m : ℕ)
    (q : (Fin m → (colimit F : CommRingCat)) →ₗ[(colimit F : CommRingCat)]
      (Fin n → (colimit F : CommRingCat))) :
    ∃ (i : I) (qi : (Fin m → F.obj i) →ₗ[F.obj i] (Fin n → F.obj i)),
      Nonempty ((extendScalars (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.ι F i))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (F.obj i) (ULift.{v} ((Fin n → F.obj i) ⧸ LinearMap.range qi))) ≅
        ModuleCat.of (colimit F : CommRingCat)
          (ULift.{v} ((Fin n → (colimit F : CommRingCat)) ⧸ LinearMap.range q)))
